vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: ceo
Version: 1.1.1

The skill bundle consists entirely of markdown files providing strategic and operational guidance for an AI agent acting as a CEO. The `SKILL.md` explicitly declares `"bins":[]` (no external binaries required) and states that the skill makes no external API calls, no network requests, does not access files outside its auxiliaries, and does not store confidential data. All content is informational, with no executable code, shell commands, or prompt injection attempts designed to subvert the agent's purpose or security controls. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence, or obfuscation across any of the provided files.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only CEO advisory pack whose requested resources and instructions match its stated purpose and do not ask for credentials, installs, or external network access.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (CEO guidance) match the provided assets: strategy.md, finance.md, fundraising.md, board.md, people.md, operations.md, and decisions.md. There are no declared binaries, environment variables, or config paths that would be unrelated to giving executive advice.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the companion files are advisory and specify escalation to humans for high-risk items. The runtime instructions do not direct the agent to read arbitrary system files, access environment variables, or make network calls; the SKILL.md explicitly states 'No external API calls' and 'No data leaves your machine.' This content is narrowly scoped to providing strategic guidance.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install specification and no code files to write or execute. As an instruction-only skill it has minimal filesystem and execution footprint.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no credentials, no environment variables, and no config paths. That is proportionate for a guidance-only CEO skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false (no forced permanent inclusion). disable-model-invocation is false (normal — the agent may invoke autonomously), but there are no extra privileges, no config writes, and nothing that modifies other skills or system settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent and is just a set of advisory documents for CEO decision-making. Before using it with confidential material, confirm your agent runtime enforces the 'no external API calls' behavior if you plan to paste sensitive business data into prompts; treat the guidance as advisory (not legal/financial advice) and follow the skill's own rule to escalate major decisions to a human. If you want additional assurance, test the skill in a sandboxed environment and avoid sending highly sensitive documents into any third-party service when interacting with the agent.
